meta.title: Sudoku — classic sudoku without ads
meta.description: Classic 9 × 9 sudoku in four levels, with notes and hints that explain. No ads, no accounts, no tracking; works offline.

why.fullHouse: All the other digits are already there — only {digit} is missing.

hiddenSingle.row: {digit} cannot go into any other free cell of the row — so it goes into the highlighted one.
hiddenSingle.col: {digit} cannot go into any other free cell of the column — so it goes into the highlighted one.
hiddenSingle.box: {digit} cannot go into any other free cell of the box — so it goes into the highlighted one.

why.nakedSingle: Every other digit is already in its row, column or box — only {digit} is left.

pointing.row: In this box {digit} can only be in one row. So it cannot be anywhere else in that row.
pointing.col: In this box {digit} can only be in one column. So it cannot be anywhere else in that column.

claiming.row: In this row {digit} can only be inside one box. So it cannot be in the other cells of that box.
claiming.col: In this column {digit} can only be inside one box. So it cannot be in the other cells of that box.

nakedPair.row: These two cells can only hold {a} and {b}. So {a} and {b} go there, and nowhere else in the row.
nakedPair.col: These two cells can only hold {a} and {b}. So {a} and {b} go there, and nowhere else in the column.
nakedPair.box: These two cells can only hold {a} and {b}. So {a} and {b} go there, and nowhere else in the box.

hiddenPair.row: In this row {a} and {b} fit only into the two highlighted cells. So those cells are taken by them — any other digit can go from their notes.
hiddenPair.col: In this column {a} and {b} fit only into the two highlighted cells. So those cells are taken by them — any other digit can go from their notes.
hiddenPair.box: In this box {a} and {b} fit only into the two highlighted cells. So those cells are taken by them — any other digit can go from their notes.

nakedTriple.row: Between them these three cells can only hold {a}, {b} and {c}. So those digits go there, and nowhere else in the row.
nakedTriple.col: Between them these three cells can only hold {a}, {b} and {c}. So those digits go there, and nowhere else in the column.
nakedTriple.box: Between them these three cells can only hold {a}, {b} and {c}. So those digits go there, and nowhere else in the box.

hiddenTriple.row: In this row {a}, {b} and {c} fit only into the three highlighted cells. So those cells are taken by them — any other digit can go from their notes.
hiddenTriple.col: In this column {a}, {b} and {c} fit only into the three highlighted cells. So those cells are taken by them — any other digit can go from their notes.
hiddenTriple.box: In this box {a}, {b} and {c} fit only into the three highlighted cells. So those cells are taken by them — any other digit can go from their notes.

xWing.rows: In both rows {digit} fits only into the same two columns. So in those columns it will be in these rows — and nowhere else in the columns.
xWing.cols: In both columns {digit} fits only into the same two rows. So in those rows it will be in these columns — and nowhere else in the rows.

swordfish.rows: In these three rows {digit} fits only into the same three columns. So in those columns it will be in these rows — and nowhere else in the columns.
swordfish.cols: In these three columns {digit} fits only into the same three rows. So in those rows it will be in these columns — and nowhere else in the rows.

why.xyWing: The cell with the solid frame holds {x} or {y}. If it is {x}, one dashed cell must be {z}; if it is {y}, the other one. Either way one of them is {z} — so a cell that sees both dashed cells cannot be {z}.
why.xyzWing: The cell with the solid frame holds {x}, {y} or {z}; the dashed ones {x} or {z} and {y} or {z}. Whatever happens, one of the three is {z} — so a cell that sees all three cannot be {z}.

hiddenSingle.row: After the steps before, {digit} fits in this row only into the highlighted cell.
hiddenSingle.col: After the steps before, {digit} fits in this column only into the highlighted cell.
hiddenSingle.box: After the steps before, {digit} fits in this box only into the highlighted cell.

whyAfter.nakedSingle: After the steps before, only {digit} is left for this cell.

about.title: About the game
about.rules: Fill the board with the digits 1 to 9 so that every row, every column and every 3 × 3 box holds each digit exactly once. Every puzzle has one solution, and you never need to guess.
about.text: Sudoku without ads, accounts or tracking. Progress stays on this device. Works offline.
about.keys: Keyboard: arrows — choose a cell, 1–9 — digit, Backspace, Delete or 0 — erase, N — notes, H — hint, Ctrl+Z — undo, Ctrl+Y — redo, Esc — close.
